agent.cli.exeUnknown: Cannot tell where this program is: {error}
agent.cli.newerRunning: An agent of a newer build ({build}) is running on this host. Update the app
agent.cli.oldWontStop: The agent of the previous version does not stop
agent.cli.portUsage: Give the port number between 1 and 65535 (example: specboard-agent port 8788)
agent.cli.usage:
Usage: specboard-agent <role>
  serve     main process: keeps the project database and the core and stays resident (attach or start launches it)
  attach    path for each connection: hands the app's lines to the main process (the SpecBoard app launches it over SSH)
  start     start the main process (from the host's shell; left as it is when running)
  stop      stop the main process
  status    whether the main process is running (and whether MCP is listening)
  port <n>  change the port the main process listens on for MCP (kept in the user's settings)
  hub …      the hub: where agents share projects with each other (see specboard-agent hub)
agent.hub.agentOlder: The agent is of an older version (lines of form {agent}; the hub speaks {hub}). Connect the app to this agent to renew the agent
agent.hub.badId: An agent's id is up to 64 letters, digits, - and _, beginning with a letter or a digit
agent.hub.badKey: The public key must be one line of ssh-ed25519
agent.hub.badName: Enter the agent's name in 1 to 80 characters
agent.hub.badTo: Enter where the hub is as one word ssh takes as a destination (for example sbhub@host; one beginning with - is not taken)
agent.hub.busy: This agent is busy with other agents' calls now. Wait a little and try again
agent.hub.helloFirst: The first line must be hello
agent.hub.hubOlder: The hub is of an older version (lines of form {hub}; the agent speaks {agent}). Connect the app to the hub to renew the hub
agent.hub.idTaken: An agent with the id {id} is already a member
agent.hub.keyTaken: That key is already a member's ({name})
agent.hub.linkEnded: The ssh to the hub ended ({code})
agent.hub.listUnreadable: Cannot read the hub's members ({path}). Put the file right, then start the hub again
agent.hub.nameTaken: An agent named "{name}" is already a member
agent.hub.newerRunning: A hub of a newer build ({build}) is running on this host. Update the app
agent.hub.noHostKeys: Cannot read this host's host keys (ssh_host_*_key.pub in {dir})
agent.hub.noHostKeysGiven: The hub's host keys are missing (hostKeys lists "kind key")
agent.hub.notAMembers: A line an agent's connection cannot use: {line}
agent.hub.notMember: {id} is not a member of the hub
agent.hub.notRunning: The hub is not running (connecting the app to the hub starts it)
agent.hub.oldWontStop: The hub of the version before does not stop
agent.hub.placeUnwritable: The path of the hub's place ({path}) cannot be written in a key's line (put it where the path holds no " or \)
agent.hub.unreadable: The line cannot be read (one JSON object a line)
agent.hub.usage:
Usage: specboard-agent hub <role>
  serve            the hub's main process: stays resident with its members and hands the agents' lines on (attach launches it)
  attach           path for each connection: hands the app's lines to the main process (the SpecBoard app launches it over SSH)
  attach --as <id> an agent's connection (launched by the key's line the hub wrote to authorized_keys)
  stop             stop the main process
  status           whether the main process is running
agent.mcp.allInUse: Every MCP connection is in a request now. Send it again shortly
agent.mcp.portRange: The port must be between 1 and 65535
agent.mcp.readOnlyGone: There is no read-only connection (/mcp/read). Connect to /mcp again (the tools that read are on /mcp too)

agent.screens.appUnreadable: Cannot read the answer of the app of window "{name}"
agent.screens.argumentsUnreadable: Cannot read the arguments of app_control
